name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: The player who loves the Fork and the player known for the Arabian mate are in the same camp.
Anatoly and the player with the Glass set are in different camps.
Garry, Pin, and Rosewood belong to different players.
Garry goes with exactly three of Italian, Pin, Boxwood, and Anastasia's.
The player who loves the Zwischenzug and the player with the Boxwood set are in different camps.
